item.title: 6 dead in road crash in Rajasthan’s Dausa
item.description: JAIPUR: Six men were killed when a car in which they were travelling collided with a truck in Dausa district, police said on Wednesday. item.title: Markets open higher; turn choppy amid mixed global trends
item.description: MUMBAI: Equity benchmark indices started on a positive note on Wednesday, with Sensex rising over 200 points in early trade, amid mixed trends from global markets. item.title: Helicopter makes emergency landing at Palghar school ground after technical snag; no injuries
item.description: MUMBAI: A chopper used for training made an emergency landing on a school ground in Maharashtra’s Palghar district after developing a technical problem, officials said on Wednesday.
